name: ML001 Defensive-Profile Loss Filter
interpretation: Strong recent net-rating edge plus meaningful rest advantage, while excluding cases where the side's recent defensive advantage is too extreme. The defensive cap was selected from discovery-only loss forensics and then tested forward without retuning.
notes: Nearby 5.0-6.0 defensive-cap thresholds remain strong, reducing concern that 5.492 is a knife-edge fit.
Intersections with V2_001 showed very high headline hit rates but failed validation consistency or had very small samples, so they remain research-only.
Totals, ATS and novel flow/workload lanes remain below this method's probability/ROI standard.
